verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents project-level real-time notifications that can be sent to email, Slack, and PagerDuty, where it can create, update, and resolve incidents. Webhooks fire for the same triggers as the other channels, which implies configurable trigger rules. However, the evidence never describes environment or severity filters, or specific triggers such as new item, frequency spike, or affected-user thresholds. Person tracking exists but is not shown as an alert condition. missing for 10: documented environment/severity routing filters, per-rule thresholds for new issue, frequency spike and affected-user count, independent or hands-on corroboration of alert rule configuration.
